title: Load limits of the two outputs
body_md: Pin 6 and pin 7 are transistor outputs. They supply 12 V and may be loaded with 500 mA. For loads requiring more than 500 mA a relay must be used; the source requires high-quality automotive relays with a free-wheeling diode. According to the source, overloading voids the warranty.
prev_context: Before this stands the connection of the alarm system.
next_context: The list of the three switching modes follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 11: equivalent in substance, including 12 V, 500 mA, the relay requirement, the free-wheeling diode and the warranty consequence. Neither version names short-circuit or over-temperature protection, a resting state after restart, or a permissible load type; that gap remains.
